title: Document Extraction Schema Template
description: Template for creating custom extraction schemas. Define the structure of data you want to extract from your PDFs.

effectiveDate.description: When the document takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD format)

documentNumber.description: Official document identifier or reference number

extractedData.description: Main data array - each item represents one extracted entity/record

category.description: Category/type of this record (used for color-coding in Excel)

description.description: Main description or text of this record

value.description: Numerical value, measurement, or specific data point
